subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): let runtime completions request reasoning

question: Should `runtime.llm.complete` accept the complete canonical `ThinkLevel` union, including `ultra`, or expose only the reasoning levels currently supported by prepared completions?
rationale: This creates a shipped plugin SDK contract, and choosing whether `ultra` is public requires an intentional compatibility decision rather than relying on the current fall-through behavior.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Exclude `ultra` from the new parameter and documentation until the prepared completion path has a defined normalization contract for it.

options.title: Implement full normalization
options.body: Keep the full `ThinkLevel` type but add explicit provider-safe `ultra` normalization with focused tests and live proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers define one stable reasoning-effort contract shared by plugin and core completion callers.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public contract
recommendation.body: Exclude `ultra` from the new parameter and documentation until the prepared completion path has a defined normalization contract for it.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reasoning-normalization implementation and its provider-facing contract originate in steipete's feature-history change.
